blind_spots.blind_spot: TAK-GUIDE is explicitly built to add 'ML-enabled gesture control to AFSOC tactical-awareness systems for drone engagement,' yet the company's own site never uses the word TAK, ATAK, or describes any C2/tactical-display integration.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Gesture control for drone engagement has to slot into an operator's existing tactical-awareness display and workflow under load — a still-prototype effort with zero public description of that integration path is exactly where transitions stall.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The TAK-GUIDE work exists only in SBIR award records; the company's brand voice has moved entirely to consumer cognitive wellness.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: channel notes: 'Pison's TAK-GUIDE Phase II effort adds ML-enabled gesture control to AFSOC tactical-awareness systems for drone engagement'

blind_spots.blind_spot: No discussion anywhere of glove compatibility, NVG interference, or signal reliability under load/stress for a gesture-control system meant for drone-engagement operators.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Electroneurography gesture sensing that works on a resting wrist in a marketing demo is a different engineering problem than reading nerve signals through gloves, sweat, and adrenaline during an engagement — a gap that kills adoption if not solved.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Public product design and messaging optimize for the consumer wellness use case (5-minute daily test, resting-state sensing), not high-stress tactical gesture recognition.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'A light flashes, you flex your wrist.' [60-second test description]

blind_spots.blind_spot: Still 'status: prototype' per SBIR channel notes with no ATO/RMF/ITAR language despite the tactical-awareness/drone-engagement use case.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A prototype gesture-control layer for drone engagement will need to cross an ATO before it ever integrates with a program-of-record C2 system — the company's public materials give no indication this is being engineered for from day one.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Focus and public narrative center on the sensor/AI IP and the consumer commercialization path, not the government accreditation pipeline for the tactical variant.
